original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔军方称兵变后“逐步恢复控制”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔军方表示，在首都尼亚美国际机场附近军事基地发生兵变后，正“逐步恢复控制”。据国防部长萨利富·莫迪将军宣读的声明，一群士兵违反军规试图扣押战友并开枪，但安全部队迅速反应，已控制局势。目前尚无伤亡或具体细节的独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔军方称在兵变后逐步恢复控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Niger's military on Saturday said it was "gradually regaining control" after mutineers started holding soldiers hostage at a military base next to the capital's airport and fired shots.

key_facts.fact: 兵变发生在尼亚美国际机场附近的军事基地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a military base next to the capital's airport

key_facts.fact: 国防部长声明称安全部队已控制局势
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The prompt reaction of the defence and security forces made it possible to contain this mutiny and gradually regain control of these sites.

uncertainties: 兵变的具体细节和伤亡情况尚未独立证实
目前仅有一个来源（AfricaNews）报道此事
